damageByLevel.note: Script multipliers are the level-11 (max) values. Damage at skill level L = multiplier x share[L-1]. Checked against the game's skill texts at every level.

notes: damage multipliers are per damage block, at max skill level: atk 2.45 = 245% ATK at level 11, 122.5% at level 1.
DoT values are fractions per tick (0.01 = 1% of the target's max HP), capped at maxPerTick x the caster's stat.
mana lists extra mana a skill grants; the base Ultimate mana gain is time-based (GameplayData ManaValues.UltManaPerSec, scaled by mode multipliers and Mana Generation) - see issue #124.
unconfirmed: How many times a damage block runs (loops, multi-hit sequences, per-target) is not resolved.
Which byLevel table feeds which value is not resolved; tables are listed in graph order.
